- **Popcorn with nutritional yeast** — savory and vegan. Healthline describes nutritional yeast as a high-quality plant protein, but doesn’t state protein per serving or a specific prep time for this combination. [Healthline vegan snack ideas](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/vegan-snacks)
- **Hummus and raw vegetables** — savory, vegan, and quick to assemble. The article doesn’t provide a protein amount or an exact time. [Healthline vegan snack ideas](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/vegan-snacks)

For a verified **≤5-minute** recipe, Healthline lists a **Green Smoothie with Spinach, Cucumber and Pineapple** at **4 minutes and 17 g protein**, but it isn’t savory. [Healthline High Protein Recipes](https://www.healthline.com/recipes/high-protein?filters=recipe-vegan)

So, based on the Healthline pages checked, I couldn’t confirm a recipe that meets all four criteria at once.
